I'll pay for the damage that I did to your car.

jyutping: hei1 mong6 wui6 ji5 zeon2 si4 hoi1 ci2 laa1！

english.text: Regarding Moore's Law, some researchers in the early 2020s pointed out that the transistor was about to shrink back to atom-sized particles, reaching the limit, so it wouldn't get smaller.

jyutping: jau5 gwaan1 mo1 aa3 ding6 leot6，hai2 2020 nin4 doi6 co1 jau5 jin4 gau3 ze2 zi2 ceot1，din6 zing1 tai2 zau6 faai3 suk1 dou3 dak1 faan2 jyun4 zi2 gam3 sai3 nap1，dou3 zo2 gik6 haan6，so2 ji5 m4 wui5 zoi3 dim2 joeng2 bin3 sai3。
text: 有關摩亞定律，喺 2020 年代初有研究者指出，電晶體就快縮到得返原子咁細粒，到咗極限，所以唔會再點樣變細。
